arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the throughput after restarting pgbouncer to ensure it returns to normal levels. Investigate the root cause of the connection pool exhaustion and implement a long-term fix. Export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem.
arguments.summary: Investigated the failed-jobs backlog and found 1204 entries. Noted an alert indicating a connection pool exhaustion issue in prod pgbouncer, which was restarted. The service is now being monitored.
